<?php

namespace App\Shop;

final class Discount
{
    public static function compute(int $subtotalMinor, bool $isNewCustomer): int
    {
        if (! $isNewCustomer || $subtotalMinor < 10_000_000) {
            return 0;
        }

        return (int) round($subtotalMinor * 0.1);
    }
}
